gpu_benchmark_info.fields: 256^3 float32 p_curr and p_prev with independent uniform [-0.5, 0.5) samples (torch.Generator seed 0)
gpu_benchmark_info.errors: err_max_* and err_rms_* are absolute errors of one leapfrog step against the same step in float64: separable and direct steps against shifted sums with half-sample reflecting walls, the k-space step against float64 rfftn/irfftn; the single-pass FDTD kernels are unchanged and not re-validated here
gpu_benchmark_info.timing: mean and standard deviation in ms per step over 10 CUDA-Event batches (direct: 6 batches); launch parameters (config_*) are tuned by timing at start-up, and means differed by up to 3% between two complete runs, more than the within-run standard deviations
gpu_benchmark_info.direct: Triton dense W^3 stencil step on a z-padded copy of p_curr, four x-planes per program
gpu_benchmark_info.kspace: periodic cuFFT step split into L2-resident chunks (2-D real transforms per group of x-planes; x transform, spectral multiply and inverse x transform per group of y-rows)
gpu_benchmark_info.sep: Triton x fan-out, y, and z fan-in + update passes over L2-resident slabs; fp16 stores the two slab intermediates in float16 (fields and accumulation stay float32)
